note: Committed test-adjacent data (same convention as tests/release/ci_retirement_scrub.json and ci_topology_timings_postshrink.json). Narrative, cost analysis and the T006 verdict live in tests/release/coverage_breadth_evidence.md.

marker_mismatch_exception_set.purpose: FR-016. Tests the retiring step selects and EVERY matrix slice deselects, because the retired step's marker expression did not exclude the `performance` family while every slice does. These are the declared exception to 'no per-file coverage regression'.

retiring_step_selection.source: Makefile FAST_TIER_DIRS / FAST_TIER_MARKERS, run by .github/workflows/ci-quality.yml's `sonarcloud` job via `make test-fast` until #4334 retired it
retiring_step_selection.marker_expression: (fast or unit) and not slow and not e2e and not integration and not regression and not distribution and not live_adapter and not stress and not windows_ci and not platform_darwin

retiring_step.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit tests/status tests/cli tests/specify_cli/runtime tests/architectural/test_no_retired_subsystems.py -m "(fast or unit) and not slow and not e2e and not integration and not regression and not distribution and not live_adapter and not stress and not windows_ci and not platform_darwin" -n auto --dist loadfile --cov=charter --cov=doctrine --cov=glossary --cov=kernel --cov=mission_runtime --cov=runtime --cov=specify_cli --cov-report=xml:retiring-step.xml -p no:cacheprovider -q

provenance.kind: local run (no CI run id — this branch has not been pushed; see coverage_breadth_evidence.md 'What could not be measured here')

matrix_union_after.why: The post-change matrix union is the reconciliation of all 34 shard reports produced by a real ci-modules.yml run. Reproducing it locally means running the entire test suite, which CLAUDE.md's test policy assigns to the CI agent, not to an implementer.
matrix_union_after.retrieval: gh run download <ci-aggregate run id> -n ci-aggregate-reconciled-coverage -D recon/

slice_breadth_probe.purpose: WP01's own effect, isolated: ONE slice run twice over an identical test selection, narrow --cov vs the broadened set. Per-file monotonicity is checked from these two reports.
